selection.rule: First six originals in order. Every A/B source/completion/correctness gate and exact joins must pass, states must agree. Both B latency gates must pass: p99<=25ms,p999<=100ms,every-minute-p99<=25ms. Baseline A latency failures remain reported but do not block selection. EACH pair B/A p99<=0.90,p999<=1.00. Only then run sustained-b1 1800s in same configuration. No default promotion.

initialization.scope: fresh CREATE_NEW, full zero-write/readback and force(true); same overlay and sync2; startup cost excluded from arrival latency and reported separately; no rollover/recovery claim

stages.scope: same-kernel CLOCK_MONOTONIC; commit/record publication anchored at start of their measured visibility intervals; file-force includes OS descheduling; no physical-media causal claim

forceWait.scope: CPU counter envelopes bound off-CPU time. State and wchan are sampled observations, not exact duration attribution. R means running OR runnable. Schedstats/delayacct disabled; no physical-device latency claim.
